title: Chapter 663 - 663 Joint Examination; Worry!

Chapter 663 - 663 Joint Examination; Worry!

Chapter 663 - 663 Joint Examination; Worry!

663 Joint Examination; Worry!

In the blink of an eye, the next day arrived.

Lin Fan had yet to enter the classroom when he heard a heated discussion.

“Have you guys seen the news?”

“Are you talking about the killing of the beast tide? Of course, I have! It’s so awesome. So much lightning fell from the sky, instantly killing hundreds of thousands of powerful exotic beasts!”

“I heard that it’s the doing of the hero from a thousand years ago, Lin Fan!”

“From today onward, Lin Fan is my idol!”

“It’d be great if I could be one-tenth as strong as him in the future!”

…

When Lin Fan heard these words, he smiled and did not mind them too much.

Zhang Wenzhuo looked to the left and right.

He looked a little nervous.

Lin Fan could not help but ask, “What’s wrong?”

After all, he was his roommate now.

If the other party encountered any trouble, Lin Fan did not mind helping him settle it.

“Do you know who sent down the terrifying lightning yesterday and instantly killed the beast tide?” Zhang Wenzhuo lowered his voice and asked.

Lin Fan nodded. “Lin Fan.”

He said this with absolute certainty.

It was because he was the one who did it.

Zhang Wenzhuo nodded. “That’s right. It’s Lin Fan. The Lin Fan from 1,000 years ago! His name is the same as yours!”

Then, he looked to his left and right nervously.

“I received a message from Lin Fan this morning. Don’t tell anyone.”

Then, he quietly opened the folding display in his pocket.

[Hello, I’m Lin Fan. As I’ve used up too much energy to kill the beast tide, I’m now weak and powerless. I’m trapped underground and urgently need 1,000 World Coins to buy nutritional supplements. After I recover my energy, I’ll pay you back a hundredfold! Also, I’ll teach you a supreme combat skill! [Card number: 6287*******]

Zhang Wenzhuo said, “I transferred 1,000 World Coins to him early in the morning. Lin Fan should be able to eat the supplements soon. I didn’t expect that I would be able to help such a big shot one day, hehe!”

At this point, Zhang Wenzhuo could not help but reveal a blissful and smug smile.

Happiness?

Proud?

That was right! That was it!

That was because, like many others, he had already regarded Lin Fan as his idol.

How could he not be happy when he managed to help his idol?

Moreover, his idol would teach him a supreme combat skill!

Lin Fan, who was standing at the side, had a weird look on his face.

Such fake advertisements had existed since a thousand years ago.

However, very few people were deceived at that time.

He did not expect that there were similar advertisements nowadays.

In the end, someone around him was deceived?

How did Zhang Wenzhuo get into Jiangbei University?

Zhang Wenzhuo was still proud. “Lin Fan, don’t worry. After Lin Fan teaches me a combat skill, I’ll mention you to him. You’re both named Lin Fan. Maybe he’ll teach you something.”

“Then… I’ll have to trouble you.” Lin Fan patted Zhang Wenzhuo’s shoulder earnestly.

“It’s a small matter!” Zhang Wenzhuo waved his hand and smiled.

…

At this moment, the school bell rang.

Then, Qin Chuan strode in.

He first swept his gaze across the class and easily knew that no one was missing. He nodded in satisfaction and said, “I believe everyone has already seen the news. The beast tide crisis has been resolved! Everyone can enter and leave the campus as usual.

“Of course, you still have to pay attention to your safety. After all, mutated beasts aren’t the only dangerous things in this world!

“In addition, Jiangbei University, Xia University, and the Western University are planning to hold a joint exam in Jiangbei. The exam will be divided into two categories: mecha and arena.

“This assessment will be personally hosted by Chief Hu Yixiao. Those who perform well and obtain good results will receive awards and energy stones from the school, the Xia Alliance, and the World Alliance.”

As soon as he said this, the students cried out in excitement.

Jiangbei University, Xia University, and Western University were the top three universities in the world.

The joint examination of the three schools was an extremely rare event. Furthermore, this joint examination was hosted by the high and mighty Hu Yixiao.

The outstanding ones would be rewarded with many rewards.

This assessment was taking place after they became special ability users.

This was definitely an opportunity for them, a very good opportunity!

Qin Chuan took in everyone’s expressions and nodded his head slightly.

Then, he continued, “The joint examination of the three schools will be held in three days. The whole school will be on holiday for the next two days. Everyone, go back and adjust your condition to prepare for the joint examination!”

“Yes, Teacher!” the students shouted in unison.

It had to be said that the world a thousand years later was indeed not bad.

One had to know…

The other two universities were thousands of kilometers away from Jiangbei.

If it was a thousand years ago, the competition would have been arranged at least a week later.

This was because they would need two to three days to travel.

In addition, they needed some time to get over the jet lag.

Now, they could reach Jiangbei in half a day by supersonic plane.

As for jet lag, a pill could solve it.

…

After Qin Chuan left, Lin Fan saw that Xia Xue’s pretty face was a little red. He asked, “Are you nervous?”

“A little.” After Xia Xue heard Lin Fan’s voice, her pretty face turned even redder.

Lin Fan said, “It’s just a normal exam. Just relax. You’ll be fine.”

For some reason, after Xia Xue heard his words, she felt a lot more at ease.

“Alright,” she said with a smile.

The two of them chatted as they walked. They separated at a fork in the road.

When Lin Fan turned his head, he happened to see his roommate, Zhang Wenzhuo.

Most of the students were excited when they found out that they were going to take the joint examination.

However, Zhang Wenzhuo’s face was filled with worry.

“Zhang Wenzhuo, what’s wrong?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

When Zhang Wenzhuo saw that it was Lin Fan, he could not help but become spirited.

He first looked around before saying in a low voice, “Do you think that hero from a thousand years ago, Lin Fan, will teach me that powerful combat skill in the next two days?

“If he teaches it to me in the next two days, I’ll definitely get good results in the joint examination!

“Perhaps, Chief Hu Yixiao might even take a fancy to me!”

At this point, Zhang Wenzhuo was so excited that his face turned red.

It was as if he could already see himself defeating one student after another, becoming the final one standing.

However, Zhang Wenzhuo quickly frowned and said, “But will Hu Yixiao ask me where I got the combat skill?

“How should I answer him, then? If I tell the truth, I wonder if the Lin Fan from a thousand years ago would mind.”

Lin Fan looked at his serious expression and almost laughed out loud.

This fellow was thinking a little too far ahead.
